description: Implementation of the OpenMaxComponent class for managing OpenMAX IL components, including buffer management, port configuration, tunneling, and state transitions.

classes.name: OpenMaxComponent
classes.description: Class managing OpenMAX IL component lifecycle, buffers, ports, and tunneling.

methods.name: SetOutputComponent
methods.description: Sets the output component for tunneling.

methods.name: CloseTunnel
methods.description: Closes the tunnel chain of components.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Transitions the component to the executing state.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data buffers to the component.

methods.name: DropOutputBuffer
methods.description: Drops an output buffer, optionally refilling it.

methods.name: AllocateBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a buffer for a specific port.

methods.name: DisableOutputPort
methods.description: Disables and frees output port buffers.

methods.name: EnableInputPortAndAllocateBuffers
methods.description: Enables input port and allocates buffers.

methods.name: EnableOutputPortAndAllocateBuffer
methods.description: Enables output port and allocates buffers.

methods.name: EnableOutputTunnelling
methods.description: Sets up tunneling to output component.

methods.name: OnOutputSettingChanged
methods.description: Marks that output settings have changed.

methods.name: OnEmptyBufferDone
methods.description: Callback for when an input buffer is emptied.

methods.name: OnFillBufferDone
methods.description: Callback for when an output buffer is filled.
